origin: Akkodis ASP Team, a French outfit, began its journey with a humble vision: to bridge the gap between amateur enthusiasm and professional racing rigor. Founded by Jérôme Policand, a racing enthusiast with a knack for spotting talent, the team initially focused on providing opportunities for young, aspiring drivers. Their early years were marked by shoestring budgets and a reliance on ingenuity, often repurposing parts and relying on the unwavering dedication of a small, tight-knit crew. A pivotal moment came in 2011 when they secured a surprise podium finish at the Spa 24 Hours, proving their potential and attracting the attention of larger sponsors, leading to a steady climb through the GT racing ranks. The arrival of Akkodis as a title sponsor marked a turning point, providing the financial muscle to compete at a higher level while retaining their core values.
philosophy: The Akkodis ASP Team operates on a philosophy of nurturing talent and maximizing the potential of both drivers and machinery. Their approach to car development emphasizes reliability and consistency, prioritizing a well-rounded package over outright speed. Team culture is built on a foundation of camaraderie and mutual respect, fostering an environment where drivers feel empowered to take risks and push their limits, knowing they have the full support of the team behind them.
achievements: 2011: Podium finish at the Spa 24 Hours
2016: Blancpain GT Series Endurance Cup – Pro-Am Champion
Multiple race wins in various GT World Challenge Europe events
Consistently competitive entries in major endurance races like the 24 Hours of Le Mans (GTE Am)
Success in developing young drivers who have progressed to higher levels of motorsport

teamPrincipal.name: Jérôme Policand
teamPrincipal.background: A former racing driver himself, Jérôme Policand brings a wealth of experience and a keen eye for talent to the Akkodis ASP Team. His hands-on approach and ability to motivate his team have been instrumental in their success.

keyFigures.name: Jean-Luc Beaubelique
keyFigures.description: Jean-Luc Beaubelique is the experienced Sporting Director of Akkodis ASP, overseeing the operational aspects of the racing program and ensuring smooth execution on race weekends.

keyFigures.name: Nicolas Denu
keyFigures.description: Nicolas Denu is the Chief Engineer, responsible for the technical development and optimization of the race cars, working closely with the drivers to fine-tune the setups.

headquarters: The team is based near Le Luc, France, operating from a modest but functional facility. While not boasting the latest technological advancements, the workshop is well-equipped to handle the maintenance and preparation of their GT racing cars.
fanBase: Akkodis ASP Team has cultivated a loyal following, particularly among French motorsport enthusiasts. Their underdog spirit and commitment to developing young talent resonate with fans who appreciate genuine racing passion over corporate glitz.
